trophies.name: Chozo's Chosen
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.

trophies.description: Reclaim the Morph Ball after Raven Beak strips your abilities.

trophies.description: Survive your first encounter with an E.M.M.I. without being caught.

trophies.name: Robot Wars
trophies.description: Defeat a Chozo Soldier for the first time.

trophies.name: You Are Here
trophies.description: Activate your first Map Station.

trophies.name: In a Flash
trophies.description: Obtain the Flash Shift.

trophies.name: Hunter Becomes Hunted
trophies.description: Escape and destroy your first E.M.M.I. unit.

trophies.name: Sting Operation
trophies.description: Defeat Corpius.

trophies.name: Sticking Around
trophies.description: Obtain the Spider Magnet.

trophies.name: Big Lung Energy
trophies.description: Defeat Kraid.

trophies.name: Free Fall, No Falling
trophies.description: Obtain the Spin Boost.

trophies.name: Swing Time
trophies.description: Obtain the Grapple Beam.

trophies.name: Jellyfish and Chips
trophies.description: Defeat Drogyga.

trophies.name: Gotta Go Fast
trophies.description: Obtain the Speed Booster.

trophies.description: Perform your first Shinespark using the Speed Booster.

trophies.name: Now You See Me
trophies.description: Obtain the Phantom Cloak.

trophies.name: Storm Chaser
trophies.description: Defeat Escue.

trophies.name: Thunderstruck
trophies.description: Obtain the Storm Missile.

trophies.name: Plasma Ray of Sunshine
trophies.description: Obtain the Plasma Beam.

trophies.name: Here Be Dragons
trophies.description: Defeat Golzuna.

trophies.name: Wide Load
trophies.description: Obtain the Diffusion Beam.

trophies.description: Escape Experiment Z-57's grasp for the first time.

trophies.name: Cold Shoulder
trophies.description: Obtain the Ice Missile.

trophies.name: Spin to Win
trophies.description: Obtain the Screw Attack.

trophies.name: Central Intelligence
trophies.description: Defeat the Central Unit guarding Itorash.

trophies.name: Sky's the Limit
trophies.description: Obtain the Space Jump.

trophies.name: No More Experiments
trophies.description: Defeat Experiment Z-57 once and for all.

trophies.name: E.M.M.I. Exterminator
trophies.description: Defeat every E.M.M.I. unit on ZDR.

trophies.name: Ancestral Power
trophies.description: Acquire every Chozo-Soul empowered form throughout the story.

trophies.name: Fallen Idol
trophies.description: Defeat Raven Beak.

trophies.name: Awakening
trophies.description: Finish Raven Beak with the awakened power of the Chozo-Soul.

trophies.name: Untouchable
trophies.description: Defeat Raven Beak without taking damage during his final phase.

trophies.name: Last One Out
trophies.description: Trigger the final escape sequence after defeating Raven Beak.

trophies.name: Fully Charged
trophies.description: Collect every Energy Tank Part on ZDR.

trophies.name: Locked and Loaded
trophies.description: Collect every Missile Tank on ZDR.

trophies.name: Big Bada Boom
trophies.description: Collect every Power Bomb Tank on ZDR.

trophies.name: Fully Equipped
trophies.description: Obtain every main ability upgrade in the game.

trophies.name: Completionist's Dread
trophies.description: Finish the game with 100% item collection.

trophies.name: Counter Culture
trophies.description: Perform a well-timed melee counter against an enemy.

trophies.name: Against the Clock
trophies.description: Complete the game in under 4 hours to unlock bonus concept art.

trophies.name: Echoes of the Past
trophies.description: View a Chozo Memory data log for the first time.

trophies.name: Easy Does It
trophies.description: Complete the game on Rookie difficulty.

trophies.name: Bring It On
trophies.description: Unlock Hard Mode by completing the game once.

trophies.name: No Mercy
trophies.description: Complete the game on Hard Mode.

trophies.name: Bonus Round
trophies.description: Scan the Samus Aran (Metroid Dread) amiibo to receive a bonus Energy Part.

trophies.name: Robotic Reward
trophies.description: Scan an E.M.M.I. amiibo to receive a bonus reward.
